```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

concurrency:
  group: perf-benchmark-${{ github.head_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: pr-checkout

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main-checkout

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd pr-checkout
          npm ci
          cd ../main-checkout
          npm ci

      - name: Build PR branch
        run: |
          cd pr-checkout
          npm run build

      - name: Build main branch
        run: |
          cd main-checkout
          npm run build

      - name: Run benchmark
        id: benchmark
        run: |
          cd pr-checkout
          PR_TIME=$(node -e "
            const { execSync } = require('child_process');
            const times = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
              const start = Date.now();
              execSync('npm run pack', { stdio: 'ignore' });
              const end = Date.now();
              times.push((end - start) / 1000);
            }
            console.log('PR_TIMES=' + JSON.stringify(times));
            const median = times.sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(times.length / 2)];
            console.log('PR_MEDIAN=' + median.toFixed(2));
          ")
          
          cd ../main-checkout
          MAIN_TIME=$(node -e "
            const { execSync } = require('child_process');
            const times = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
              const start = Date.now();
              execSync('npm run pack', { stdio: 'ignore' });
              const end = Date.now();
              times.push((end - start) / 1000);
            }
            console.log('MAIN_TIMES=' + JSON.stringify(times));
            const median = times.sort((a, b) => a - b)[Math.floor(times.length / 2)];
            console.log('MAIN_MEDIAN=' + median.toFixed(2));
          ")
          
          echo "$PR_TIME"
          echo "$MAIN_TIME"
          echo "PR_TIME=$PR_TIME" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MAIN_TIME=$MAIN_TIME" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Calculate diff
        id: diff
        run: |
          PR_MEDIAN=$(echo ${{ env.PR_TIME }} | jq '.[3]')
          MAIN_MEDIAN=$(echo ${{ env.MAIN_TIME }} | jq '.[3]')
          DIFF_SEC=$(echo "$PR_MEDIAN - $MAIN_MEDIAN" | bc -l)
          DIFF_PERCENT=$(echo "scale=1; ($DIFF_SEC / $MAIN_MEDIAN) * 100" | bc -l)
          echo "PR_MEDIAN=$PR_MEDIAN" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MAIN_MEDIAN=$MAIN_MEDIAN" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DIFF_SEC=$DIFF_SEC" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "DIFF_PERCENT=$DIFF_PERCENT" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post comment
        uses: marocchino/sticky-pull-request-comment@v2
        with:
          header: perf-benchmark-results
          message: |
            ### Performance Benchmark Results
            
            | | Time |
            |---|---:|
            | PR branch | ${{ env.PR_MEDIAN }}s |
            | main branch | ${{ env.MAIN_MEDIAN }}s |
            | **Diff** | **${{ env.DIFF_SEC }}s (${{ env.DIFF_PERCENT }}%)** |
            
            *Benchmark results generated by GitHub Actions*
```
